audio.strategy: Hybrid generated AudioBuffer and oscillator synthesis

generatedSources.name: Piano root-note buffers
generatedSources.method: Six additive-synthesis buffers generated at startup and pitch-mapped across the keyboard

generatedSources.name: Organ voices
generatedSources.method: Web Audio oscillators combined from drawbar harmonics and percussion

generatedSources.name: Synth voices
generatedSources.method: Web Audio oscillator, filter, envelope, and LFO graph

generatedSources.name: Reverb impulse
generatedSources.method: Generated in memory with decaying noise

notes: No recorded, downloaded, remote, or bundled audio samples are used.
Piano sample playback uses generated buffers rather than recorded piano samples.
